foil.title: Energy repricing risk from Red Sea maritime disruption state
foil.scenario_short: Red Sea maritime disruption will sustain energy repricing above 73% probability over the next 30 days, driven by 78% pressure from energy supply shock and 79% state confirmation, with oil prices already at a...
foil.perspective_strategic: The 78% pressure and 79% state confirmation signals indicate a durable energy supply shock transmission path through the Red Sea, with oil prices at a five-month high confirming market pricing of sustained risk.
foil.perspective_contrarian: The 75% confidence level still allows reversal if no new directly matched reporting on Red Sea disruption appears, as the current evidence mix lacks a decisive break toward either shock or relief.
foil.actor_lens: Commodity traders: Price whether stress in Red Sea becomes durable over the 30d. Rebalance positions if the probability path moves away from 73%.
foil.top_signal: Red Sea maritime disruption state is feeding energy repricing through energy supply shock, with 78% pressure and 79% state confirmation

seismic-infrastructure.absence_reason: No product publishes a seismic forecast — earthquakes are not predictable, so there is no forecast/intel alternative to azimuth's observed USGS record. This is the honest inverse: for an observed natural-hazard fact, the sourced record IS the only trustworthy source.
